Preserve his recognizable face: thick silver-gray hair with whiter streaks, combed straight back from a high, lined forehead into a full, smooth swept-back shape; very long, bushy white eyebrows that reach past the outer corners of his eyes and droop slightly at their ends, his most recognizable feature; narrow, slightly hooded dark eyes with smile creases; long, lean face with high prominent cheekbones, slightly hollow cheeks and deep lines from nose to mouth; broad nose with a rounded tip; thin lips in a small closed smile; ears slightly prominent; warm light-tan complexion, clean shaven, no glasses.
